brief:
Israel freed nine of ten suspects detained in connection with militant settler attacks on a US journalist and European diplomats, placing them under house arrest instead, a law firm representing settlers reported, Al-Monitor said.

The move came as part of an investigation into two separate incidents involving violence by settlers. The decision to release the detainees from custody while maintaining restrictions through house arrest marked a significant shift in how authorities were handling the cases.
dek: JERUSALEM, Oct 22 (Reuters) - Nine of the 10 suspects arrested in an investigation into militant settler attacks on a US journalist and European diplomats have been released from custody and placed under house arrest, a law firm that represents settlers said.
title: Israel releases nine settler attack suspects to house arrest
